intro: Nepal's economy depends on farming, tourism and money sent home by workers abroad.

chapters.title: How Nepal earns
text: Remittances equal about a quarter of the economy. Trekking and mountaineering bring tourists. Rice, tea and cardamom are grown.
Rivers give Nepal huge hydropower potential, and it now sells electricity to India.

chapters.title: Trade
text: Nepal trades mostly with India, its giant southern neighbour.

keyTerms.meaning: Money sent home by workers abroad.
